list: Authentic Information: Provide correct shipping details and a working contact number to avoid delivery issues.
Timely Payment: Ensure successful payment before confirming the order (for prepaid orders).
Order Cancellation: Orders can be canceled only within the allowed cancellation window.
Refund Policy: Refunds will be processed only for valid cases of non-delivery, damaged items, or incorrect orders, as per platform policy.
Respectful Communication: Maintain respectful interaction with farmers and support staff.
No Abuse: Misuse of services, false complaints, or abusive behavior will lead to account restrictions.
Reviews: Feedback and reviews must be genuine and reflect real experiences.
Data Usage: Your data will be used for order processing, support, and service improvement, in line with our privacy policy.
Delivery: Choose between Express, Free, or Normal Delivery based on your preference and eligibility.
Translation & Accessibility: You may use the translation feature to view content in your preferred language.

about.title: About Harvest Hub
about.subtitle: Connecting farmers and consumers for a better food ecosystem
about.missionDescription: At Harvest Hub, we're on a mission to revolutionize the way food travels from farm to table. We believe in creating a marketplace that benefits both farmers and consumers by removing unnecessary middlemen and fostering direct relationships.
about.missionDescription2: By empowering local farmers with technology and direct market access, we help ensure fair prices for farmers while providing consumers with the freshest, most nutritious food possible.
about.missionDescription3: Our platform bridges the digital divide in agriculture, making it easier for farmers to embrace modern technology while maintaining their traditional farming wisdom. We're working toward a future where our food system is more equitable, resilient, and connected.
about.transparencyDescription: We believe in complete transparency in pricing, sourcing, and farming practices.
about.sustainabilityDescription: We promote sustainable farming practices that protect our environment for future generations.
about.communityDescription: We build strong communities by connecting farmers and consumers directly.
about.qualityDescription: We ensure the highest quality standards for all products on our platform.
about.innovationDescription: We embrace technology to make farming more efficient and accessible.

farmerStories.title: Farmer Success Stories
farmerStories.description: Hear from farmers who have embraced sustainable practices and achieved remarkable success

1.name: Rajesh Patel
1.story: I've been growing organic wheat for over 15 years. Since joining Harvest Hub, my customer base has doubled and I can focus more on sustainable farming practices.

2.name: Lakshmi Devi
2.story: Harvest Hub helped me reach customers who truly appreciate our traditional rice varieties. The direct connection to buyers has transformed our small family farm.

3.name: Arvind Singh
3.story: As a grape farmer, it was challenging to establish market connections beyond my region. Harvest Hub provided the platform I needed to showcase our premium grapes nationwide.

4.name: Priya Sharma
4.story: I transitioned from commercial to organic apple farming three years ago. The transparent pricing on Harvest Hub has made this sustainable switch financially viable.

5.name: Meena Kumari
5.story: Growing organic vegetables has been my family's tradition. Through Harvest Hub, I've connected with customers who value fresh, pesticide-free produce.

6.name: Ravi Kumar
6.story: Our region is famous for chilies. Harvest Hub has helped me reach premium buyers who appreciate quality spices and are willing to pay fair prices.
